title: Okay looking, feels more like plastic than glass
text: Okay looking, feels more like plastic than glass. This table feels a little less classy than imagines, because the materials reads like a thick plastic instead of glass. When I rest my feet on it (I am 130 lbs), the legs splay outwards as if too much weight is on the table. I am going to try to dress it up with a nice copper bowl to make it look less cheap
